name: smwsprites-umbrella-buddy
title: Umbrella Buddy
description:
A critter that is carrying an umbrella. When the umbrella is open, the player will bounce on top of it. When closed, it'll act as a spike, hurts player, but can be spinjumped on. The trigger for toggling its effect can be customized (change on player jump or a flag like On/Off switch status).

Requested by Tob during Summer C3 2026. Graphics also by Tob.
